data.name: The Hero Unmasked!
data.detailed_description:
Impersonate your identical twin as the Swashbuckler, masked champion of justice! You have two weeks to rescue the REAL Swashbuckler and marry the mayor before superpowered criminals take over the city.

The Hero Unmasked is a 300,000 word interactive novel by Christopher Huang. It's entirely text-based, without graphics or sound effects, and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

As our story begins, you have everything you've ever wanted. Your TV news show is the highest rated in the city, and you're engaged to the mayor, with two weeks until the wedding. But when superpowered criminals kidnap the Swashbuckler, you realize the awful truth: the person in the ransom video is your identical twin, and everyone thinks it's you!

Now, you must draw the Swashbuckler's laser sword and wear the Swashbuckler's mask to bring down three of the city's most wanted super criminals before time runs out.

How is this going to work? Can you keep up the charade? Do you want to? When you meet the Swashbuckler's sweetheart, will you remain faithful? To whom?!

Who Is Really Behind the Mask?

  • Play as male or female, gay or straight
  • Infiltrate high society events and root out criminal hideouts
  • Uncover the true identities of Caledon City's superpowered criminals
  • Disarm a bomb and save the city's finest from destruction
  • Maintain the masquerade as you learn about the Swashbuckler's secret hero life
  • Find romance with a journalist, a pyromaniac, or a vampire
  • Become a powered hero in your own right

reviews.review:
[i]Perched on top of the steeple of All Saints Cathedral, you can see most of the city spread out around you.

Caledon City. Your city. You know exactly what you have to do.[/i]

You know, I cannot call myself a huge fan of superheroes – I do not know the whole Marvel and DC universe, I do not have any action figurines lining my shelves (well, except for some anime ones, but that is a completely different thing), and I have never imagined being one myself. Still, breathtaking adventures in the name of justice light some hidden fire inside of my heart. 

The Hero Unmasked! was on my wishlist for some time, and I am extremely grateful that CoG provided me with a copy for the review. As it turned out, this action-packed story was exactly what I needed to get some quality rest during these hot summer holidays!

[h1]My thoughts about the game[/h1]

If you have already played Heroes Rise, another superhero title by CoG, you are most probably concerned that The Hero Unmasked! might be just a copycat – after all, both of them are about superheroes saving the day, right? But fear not, my friend! These two stories are nothing alike and have their own unique motives.

First things first, what about the story? You will step into the shoes of a famous journalist who hosts the hottest show on TV. Your city is famous for its criminal activities and cunning villains, but the brightest star is the superhero called Swashbuckler. A charmer, a fighter, and just a generally good person with a great smile and a light sword. After one particularly active evening that involved an attack on your TV station and a close meeting up with Swashbuckler, you wake up in the morning to see news about…you being kidnapped and kept hostage until the city pays a hefty amount of money?! What on earth is going on here! Oh, have I forgotten to mention that you have a twin sibling? And that this very person IS the real Swashbuckler? Well, now it is up to you to take his role and find out who is plotting against you and the city. And do not forget about your wedding with the charming mayor!

If you have not guessed yet, there will be a lot of action and investigation to experience. The best part is that all of this is spiced up with a healthy dose of romance – you can fall in love with a fiery villain, a mysterious vampire and a beautiful journalist. Or just stay loyal to your fiancé/ fiancée, right? The storytelling is well-paced, so you will not fall asleep between scenes. You will also get enough time to set up your character, starting from skills and ending with general behavior. Your choices do matter, though not all of them are quite obvious or meaningful. However, I always knew what to do and how to use my best qualities at the right time.

Speaking about characters, I easily remember all the major ones because all of them are quite different. My main complaint is that some romantic interests have fixed genders. For example, I was keen on flirting with a vampire, only to find out that this is a woman. I am only interested in male partners and the same goes for my characters and their beloved ones, so I was at least a bit disappointed. Still, this is just a minor complaint as there are other great people to romance. Another important note: I would love to see more parts about my character’s sibling. There was just one childhood memory, and then a personal meeting closer to the end of the story. I do understand that he/she is supposed to be exactly like me not only appearance-wise, but I still wish there were more interactions between siblings. 

The setting is quite unusual. In addition to the common superhero tropes, there is also a lot of crazy science and magic – and not just some tricks, but actual magic with teleportation, zombies and other cool stuff.  I should mention that I found endings really satisfying. I saw consequences of my actions and how they changed the city. The epilogue had several additional choices to make, which helped to shape final bits of my superhero adventure. It took me about 7 hours go through the story once; and I am planning at least several more playthroughs to see all possible outcomes. 

And a very small but pleasant feature: I liked the overall newspaper-like design of chapters and their headlines. 

[h1]Would I recommend this game?[/h1]

As I have already said, I really enjoyed my experience with The Hero Unmasked!. Even though I cannot say that this story is something extraordinary, there are some good plot twists and engaging scenes. I was emotionally invested in my character all the way through and I had a lot of fun exploring various choices. 

Yes, there are small flaws here and there and I would not mind more background for both my character and other people, but all in all, The Hero Unmasked! is a complete adventure worth spending time and money on. Hm, and maybe there will also be a sequel? There were some small hints in one of the ending, so…
